 Intuit Beats Fiscal Q1 Goals, Gives Soft Outlook, Sells Mailchimp 
 Licensing 
 PATRICK SEITZ 
 04:21 PM ET 11/19/2026
 Financial software firm Intuit (INTU) late Thursday beat Wall Street's estimates for its fiscal first quarter but missed with its outlook. Intuit stock fell in extended trading. The Mountain View, Calif.-based company earned an adjusted $2.91 a share on sales of $4.35 billion in the quarter ended Oct. 31. Analysts surveyed by FactSet had expected earnings of $2.46 a share…
